title: Fix pagination boundaries
instruction: Fix paginate(items, page, pageSize) in src/paginate.mjs. Pages are 1-based. The result is { items, page, pages } where pages is the total number of pages (0 for an empty list). pageSize must be a positive integer, otherwise throw RangeError. page must be an integer from 1 to max(pages, 1), otherwise throw RangeError; for an empty list only page 1 is valid and returns no items.

acceptanceCriteria: out-of-range page and invalid pageSize throw RangeError
